description: This Java class 'RetrieveAclEntryStrategy' handles the 'RetrieveAclEntry' command within a persistence layer, managing retrieval of ACL entries associated with 'Thing' entities, including constructing responses or error handling.

classes.name: RetrieveAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: Handles retrieval of ACL entries for 'Thing' entities, providing methods for applying commands and managing entity tags.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve an ACL entry and returns a result containing either the entry or an error.

methods.name: extractAclEntry
methods.description: Extracts the ACL entry from the given 'Thing' based on the command.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous state for comparison or caching purposes.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the entity tag of the resulting state after command execution.
